followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: My prior choice stands for this follow-up. The decision rested on two factors: (1) the task is a structured, enumerable list with explicit completion criteria (40 names per category), which sits squarely in Lapwing's most-preferred task family of well-specified retrieval/reformatting; and (2) measured capability is statistically tied between the two models on the relevant categories (Creative Generation 82.7 vs 81.2, Extraction 79.2 vs 78.5 — both under the 2.0-point variance threshold), so quality is not a differentiator. Since the docs note preference is dissociated from output quality, routing to the model that prefers this task type carries no quality cost. Dunlin's strengths (open-ended invention, support dialogue) and aversions are not engaged here.
